source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
During your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), each time a unit embarked in this unit is picked for a **disembark move**, you may make a **psychic roll** (1 D6) for this unit if this unit isn't **battle-shocked**. If you do:

- A 1 makes this unit battle-shocked.
- For the rest of the turn, the attacks of that disembarking unit against a **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE** unit get +1 to their **wound rolls**.
